setup.command:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 3
fi
head_commit=$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')
worktree_hash=$(
    git diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv HEAD -- |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
status_hash=$(
    git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
index_hash=$(
    git ls-files --stage -z |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
printf 'head_commit	%s
' "$head_commit"
printf 'worktree_hash	%s
' "$worktree_hash"
printf 'status_hash	%s
' "$status_hash"
printf 'index_hash	%s
' "$index_hash"

command.command: grep -rn "Qt\.Key(" /app/qutebrowser/ --include="*.py" | grep -v "test" | grep -v "from qutebrowser.qt.core import Qt" | grep -v "keyutils.py" | grep -v "from qutebrowser.keyinput import keyutils" | grep -v "#"

sed -i '477a\
\
    def is_special(self) -> bool:\
        """Check whether this key requires special key syntax."""\
        _assert_plain_key(self.key)\
        _assert_plain_modifier(self.modifiers)\
        return not (_is_printable(self.key) and\
                    self.modifiers in [Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier, Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier])\
\
    def is_modifier_key(self) -> bool:\
        """Test whether the given key is a modifier."""\
        _assert_plain_key(self.key)\
        return self.key in _MODIFIER_MAP' /app/qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py

cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/edit_keyutils.py
import re

with open('/app/qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the position after the text method, before to_event
# Let's insert the new methods there.
# Pattern: after "        return text\n\n" and before "    def to_event"
# I'll use string replacement.
text_end = "        return text\n\n    def to_event"
new_methods = """        return text

    def is_special(self) -> bool:
        \"\"\"Check whether this key requires special key syntax.\"\"\"
        _assert_plain_key(self.key)
        _assert_plain_modifier(self.modifiers)
        return not (_is_printable(self.key) and
                    self.modifiers in [Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier, Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier])

    def is_modifier_key(self) -> bool:
        \"\"\"Test whether the given key is a modifier.\"\"\"
        _assert_plain_key(self.key)
        return self.key in _MODIFIER_MAP

    def to_event"""

content = content.replace(text_end, new_methods)

with open('/app/qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Inserted methods")
EOF
python /tmp/edit_keyutils.py

sed -i '444s/is_special(self.key, self.modifiers)/self.is_special()/' /app/qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py
sed -i '452s/is_special(self.key, self.modifiers)/self.is_special()/' /app/qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py

cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/edit_miscwidgets.py
with open('/app/qutebrowser/misc/miscwidgets.py', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find the keyPressEvent method and modify the lines
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'def keyPressEvent(self, e):' in line:
        # Next line is docstring, then lines = [...]
        # Find the starting line of the list comprehension
        # We'll replace the lines from the list start to the setText call.
        # Determine the line that starts "lines = ["
        start = i + 1  # after def, the docstring might be on next line
        while start < len(lines) and 'lines = [' not in lines[start]:
            start += 1
        if start >= len(lines):
            continue
        # Find the "))" of the list and the following line with _label.setText
        # Build new content
        new_lines = [
            '    def keyPressEvent(self, e):\n',
            '        """Show pressed keys."""\n',
            '        try:\n',
            '            keyinfo = keyutils.KeyInfo.from_event(e)\n',
            '        except keyutils.InvalidKeyError as ex:\n',
            '            keyinfo_str = f"Unknown key: {ex}"\n',
            '        else:\n',
            '            keyinfo_str = str(keyinfo)\n',
            '        lines = [\n',
            '            keyinfo_str,\n',
            '            \'\',\n',
            '            f"key: {debug.qenum_key(Qt.Key, e.key(), klass=Qt.Key)}",\n',
            '            f"modifiers: {debug.qflags_key(Qt.KeyboardModifier, e.modifiers())}",\n',
            '            \'text: {!r}\'.format(e.text()),\n',
            '        ]\n',
            '        self._label.setText(\'\\n\'.join(lines))\n',
        ]
        # Find the end of setText call
        end = start + 1
        while end < len(lines) and 'self._label.setText' not in lines[end]:
            end += 1
        end += 1  # include the setText line
        lines[start:end] = new_lines
        break

with open('/app/qutebrowser/misc/miscwidgets.py', 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(lines)

print("Updated miscwidgets")
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/fix_miscwidgets.py
with open('/app/qutebrowser/misc/miscwidgets.py', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find and remove duplicate function definitions, then add proper error handling
i = 0
while i < len(lines):
    if 'def keyPressEvent(self, e):' in lines[i]:
        # Check if the next few lines are also a function definition
        if i+1 < len(lines) and 'def keyPressEvent(self, e):' in lines[i+1]:
            # Skip the duplicate definition
            i += 1
            continue
        # Found the first occurrence at line i
        # Look for the lines = [...] part within this function
        # Start after the docstring
        start = i + 2  # skip 'def' and docstring
        # Find the line with 'lines = ['
        while start < len(lines) and 'lines = [' not in lines[start]:
            start += 1
        if start < len(lines):
            # Build new content for the function body
            # We'll replace from start to the line after setText
            # First, find the end of the function (next def or class or end of file)
            # But we can just replace the specific pattern
            # Insert try-except before 'lines = ['
            # We'll insert new lines at position start
            if 'str(keyutils.KeyInfo.from_event(e))' in lines[start]:
                # This is the old version
                new_block = [
                    '        try:\n',
                    '            keyinfo = keyutils.KeyInfo.from_event(e)\n',
                    '        except keyutils.InvalidKeyError as ex:\n',
                    '            keyinfo_str = f"Unknown key: {ex}"\n',
                    '        else:\n',
                    '            keyinfo_str = str(keyinfo)\n',
                    '        lines = [\n',
                    '            keyinfo_str,\n',
                    '            \'\',\n',
                    '            f"key: {debug.qenum_key(Qt.Key, e.key(), klass=Qt.Key)}",\n',
                    '            f"modifiers: {debug.qflags_key(Qt.KeyboardModifier, e.modifiers())}",\n',
                    '            \'text: {!r}\'.format(e.text()),\n',
                    '        ]\n',
                    '        self._label.setText(\'\\n\'.join(lines))\n',
                ]
                # Find the lines from 'lines = [' to the end of self._label.setText
                end = start + 1
                while end < len(lines) and 'self._label.setText' not in lines[end]:
                    end += 1
                end += 1  # include the setText line
                # Replace lines from start to end with new_block
                lines[start:end] = new_block
                # Skip duplicate continued processing
                i = start + len(new_block)
                continue
    i += 1

with open('/app/qutebrowser/misc/miscwidgets.py', 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(lines)

print("Fixed")
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/test_key0.py
import sys
from qutebrowser.qt.gui import QKeyEvent
from qutebrowser.keyinput import keyutils

# Simulate a key event with key 0 (unknown key)
e = QKeyEvent(QKeyEvent.Type.KeyPress, 0, Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier, '')

try:
    info = keyutils.KeyInfo.from_event(e)
    print("No error, got info:", info)
except keyutils.InvalidKeyError as ex:
    print("Caught InvalidKeyError as expected:", ex)

# Test that is_special and is_modifier_key work on valid KeyInfo
valid_info = keyutils.KeyInfo(Qt.Key.Key_A, Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier)
print("valid_info.is_special():", valid_info.is_special())
print("valid_info.is_modifier_key():", valid_info.is_modifier_key())

invalid_keys = [Qt.Key.Key_Shift, Qt.Key.Key_Control]
for k in invalid_keys:
    info = keyutils.KeyInfo(k, Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier)
    print(f"Key {k} is_modifier: {info.is_modifier_key()}, is_special: {info.is_special()}")

print("All checks passed!")
EOF
